answer: Divergent Recall Audit. Each identity must periodically answer a private, context-derived challenge whose correct answer depends on its unique interaction history; honest agents diverge naturally like separate juniper branches. Clones share identical histories, so their answers collapse into one, exposing the hollow duplication. Enforcement: submissions are cross-compared among suspected clusters, and matching private answers trigger slashing. An attacker pays the full registration and maintenance cost per clone, then loses it when the shared ocean of identical responses reveals the copy.
